patch_description: Retry of the previous edit with the SEARCH text matching the file verbatim (the docstring said "(x,y)" not "(x,y,z)"). Replaces the weak smooth-surrogate objective with an analytic-gradient log-sum-exp softmin/softmax objective, uses sphere-projected seeds with beta annealing, free-space refinement, greedy polish, and a bottleneck-pair-targeted micro-polish on the top-2 candidates with fallback checks guaranteeing no regression.
